title: The Seven Steps of Gospel Sharing

steps.title: Invite
steps.subtitle: (Opening prayer)
points: We remind ourselves that the Risen Lord is with us. Would someone please, invite Jesus in a prayer and welcome him.

steps.title: Read
steps.subtitle: (We need the Biblical Text)
points: Let us open our Bibles to .... Chapter ....
Would someone please read the same text again.
(Groups may find it helpful to read it in pidgin after reading it in English.)

steps.title: View with Wonder
points: Let us take time to pick out words or short phrases, read them aloud prayerfully and repeat them three times.
steps.note: (The silence after each repetition should be long enough for us to repeat the same word once or twice in our hearts.)
steps.afterwards: Will someone, please, read the same text again (if possible from a different version).

steps.title: Listen
points: We keep silence for… minutes and allow God to speak to us.

steps.title: Share
points: What has touched us personally? We share only what has touched us personally.
We do not discuss any contribution.
steps.afterwards_intro: (Afterwards, the group may choose a Word of Life:)
steps.afterwards: Which word from the text shall we choose as our Word of Life for the coming week?

steps.title: Plan for Action
points: Now we discuss any task which our group is called to do in our neighbourhood or Parish.
What new tasks need to be done?
WHO will do WHAT and WHEN?
steps.note: (Here we may also share some examples of how we have applied the Word of Life in certain situations of daily life.)

steps.title: Pray
steps.subtitle: (Concluding the prayer session)
points: Anyone who wishes may pray spontaneously.
steps.afterwards: We end with a prayer or hymn which everyone knows.

self_evaluation_general: Was there a spirit of prayer?
Was there anything which disturbed or destroyed the spirit of prayer?

self_evaluation.label: a)
questions: Was the prayer addressed directly to Jesus?

self_evaluation.label: b)
questions: Did everybody find the text before it was read?
Was the reader audible (loud enough to be heard)?

self_evaluation.label: c)
questions: Did we allow a time of silence in between the words we were picking out?
Did we read them aloud in a prayerful way?
Were there any unnecessarily long phrases?

self_evaluation.label: d)
questions: Was the time of silence too short or too long?

self_evaluation.label: e)
questions: Was there real personal sharing or preaching to others?

self_evaluation.label: f)
questions: Did we carry out our tasks?
Did we allow the spirit of God’s word to guide our discussions on our tasks?

self_evaluation.label: g)
questions: Did we allow enough time for everybody to pray spontaneously?

self_evaluation.label: h)
questions: What did our facilitator do well?

closing_note: Self-evaluation after a gospel sharing session will help a group to improve the practical use of the 7-steps.
